verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI app-builder, so the axis applies. The evidence only says published apps deploy to Figma's hosted infrastructure, and that the generated app code sits in the Make project. Portability of the output app is a different capability and earns no credit. Nothing shows Figma Make itself can be run on user infrastructure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
